metadata.title: Nvidia Bet Big on AI Stocks. Now They’re Getting Hit.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Nvidia Bet Big on AI Stocks. Now They’re Getting Hit.
Billion-dollar investments have linked dozens of companies to Nvidia’s success—and now its stumbles.
By some measures, the AI economy is the Nvidia economy. The chip giant has done more than supply the technology powering the buildout; it has helped finance it, too.
